components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: rgb(89,82,210); color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; height: 36px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(13,15,17,0.05); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(74,68,184); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(89,82,210), 0 0 0 4px #fff; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action button used for secondary nav/back actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: rgb(96,102,108); padding: 8px 12px; height: 32px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; border: none; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgb(242,246,249); color: rgb(23,27,31); }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Standard rail/panel container (SectionPanel, Score & coaching block).
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgb(210,216,221); border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(13,15,17,0.05); } .ds-card-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgb(167,174,180); margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { border: 1px solid rgb(210,216,221); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; color: rgb(23,27,31); background: #fff; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: rgb(89,82,210); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(89,82,210,0.35); }

narrative.overview: Resumegen reads as a serious, unhurried writing tool rather than a marketing surface. Gray does the load-bearing work everywhere and the brand purple is spent only where it earns attention: the primary action, focus rings, active nav state, and links. Dark mode remaps semantic roles, not primitives, so a component styled in tokens never needs a dark-mode-specific class.
keyCharacteristics: Single accent color reserved for primary actions, focus states, and active/selected UI
Flat surfaces with hairline borders; shadows are a light shadow-sm at rest, not a design feature
Radius varies by role: 6px buttons/inputs, 10px cards, 14px modals
Dark mode remaps semantic tokens only, primitives never change
IBM Plex Sans throughout, no secondary or mono typeface in product UI

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Purple appears only on the primary action, focus rings, active states, and links.

rules.name: The No-Third-Face Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans handles every text role including numeric data via tabular-nums, not a mono swap.

rules.name: The Ring-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Dark mode shadows become 1px hairline rings instead of darker shadows.

dos: Do use the semantic token classes (bg-accent-bg, text-accent-text, border-border-focus) for anything accent-colored
Do keep shadows at shadow-sm for resting surfaces; reserve shadow-lg/xl for modals and dropdowns
Do match radius to role: buttons/inputs at md, cards at lg, modals at xl
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color
Don't hardcode gray/purple hex or raw Tailwind palette classes in new components
Don't add decorative imagery, gradients, or illustration to product UI
